## Change summary

Describe the behavior, deployment, or test-contract change.

## Documentation impact

Update the value below to `updated` when related documentation changed. Use
`none` only when the change is internal and does not alter public behavior,
commands, configuration, deployment steps, or acceptance contracts.

Documentation-Impact: choose updated or none
Documentation-Impact-Reason: required when the impact is none

## Verification

- [ ] `make docs-check`
- [ ] Relevant tests
